title: SAML 2.0 setup wizard: metadata fuzz-testing, signature provenance and admin remediation
creator: Ava Patel
description: Add a deterministic metadata fuzz-testing harness into the SAML 2.0 setup wizard to detect and classify common and adversarial metadata anomalies, validate signature provenance (Assertion vs Response), and provide contextual admin remediation guidance. The harness will run both lightweight client-side preflight checks during interactive onboarding and a more exhaustive server-side job for operator validation. Outputs must map to audit log events and operator-runbooks for quick triage.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard runs a preflight metadata validation that catches malformed XML, missing certificates, duplicate entityIDs, and canonicalization issues with clear UX messages
Server-side fuzz tester runs a configurable set of mutations (namespace shims, wrapped signatures, truncated cert chains, added extraneous elements) and reports reproducible failure classes
Signature provenance analysis differentiates Assertion-signed vs Response-signed tokens and surfaces certificate chain trust issues
Admin remediation panel includes suggested fixes, one-click fingerprint update, and safe dry-run mode for config changes
All relevant events emitted to audit logs with stable event types and token-level correlation IDs
Automated tests (unit + integration) cover 80% of new validation code paths and smoke test wizard UX flows
Monitoring exposes metrics for preflight pass/fail rate, common failure buckets, and mean time to remediation
Docs and runbook published in Confluence and linked from the wizard
comments: 2025-02-11: Kickoff meeting with SecEng, Platform, and DX. Agreed fuzz-testing will be layered: client preflight (fast) + server exhaustive job (async).

2025-02-12: Decided to treat signature provenance as two orthogonal checks: canonicalization/signature verification and certificate chain validation. Trade-off: more checks add latency to preflight; we will keep preflight to a short subset and provide a 'Run full diagnostic' button.

2025-02-14: Design feedback from DX: admin remediation panel should include copy for non-security admins and a link to contextual logs. Added requirement for one-click fingerprint update with confirmation modal.

2025-02-16: Engineering spike complete. Implemented mutation set generator for metadata fuzzing. Found brittle behavior with enveloped signatures on vendor X; opened ENG-45211 to follow up with compatibility shim.
2025-02-18: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345 (includes fuzz harness and preflight UX hooks). Needs security review before merging.
2025-02-19: UX prototype posted: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExampleDoc (admin remediation flows). PM requested clearer language around clock skew remediation.
2025-02-20: Added audit events spec to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SAML+Fuzz+Tester+Audit+Events. Planning internal canary with two small customers.
Review notes: Security team asked for explicit limits on mutation depth and verified that fuzz tests will never alter customer metadata in-place without explicit admin confirmation.
attachments: GitHub PR: platform/pull/2345 - fuzz tester + preflight integration
test_plan: Unit tests for canonicalization and signature verification code paths
Integration test: preflight against a matrix of 12 IdP metadata samples (ok/ok-with-warnings/fail) using local runner
Chaos test: server-side harness runs 500 mutations against a staging IdP and compares expected failure taxonomy
Security review: manual pen-test on fuzz harness to ensure no code execution via crafted XML
End-to-end canary with two pilot customers behind feature flag
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Merge behind feature flag; enable for internal accounts only
Phase 2: Canary release to 2 pilot customers for one week with daily check-ins
Phase 3: Gradual enablement for self-serve accounts and surface a 'Run full diagnostic' opt-in
Phase 4: Default on for all accounts after 4 weeks if no regressions and false-positive rate < 3%
rollback_plan: Toggle off feature flag to remove preflight hooks immediately
Revert server-side harness deployment and drain running jobs
Run database migration revert if any lightweight telemetry schema changes introduced
Notify customers and SRE on rollback with incident postmortem within 72 hours
audit_log_events: saml.preflight.run - details: metadata fingerprint, preflight_result, latency_ms
notes: Keep preflight deterministic and idempotent; never persist mutated artifacts back to customer metadata store without explicit admin approval.
Be explicit about privacy in UX: logs and reproducer artifacts may include metadata; only surface minimal necessary fields to UI and redact certificate bodies in public links.
Coordinate with Compliance on audit schema retention policy (90 days default) before GA.
Follow up: small RFC to standardize SAML audit event names across other SSO connectors (ENG-47000 proposed).
